name: DashboardSwitcher
title: Blocks/Dashboard/DashboardSwitcher
summary: The dashboards hub: one page that switches between every dashboard of the account. A `PageHeader` named Dashboards sits over the controls row: a grouped `Select` of the dashboards (Platform, Security, Business and Yours) with a chart icon, a `FilterMenu` that sets the shared Period and counts it on its Filter button, and a Refresh `IconButton` in a `Tooltip` at the end. The applied period shows as a removable chip in `FilterMenu.ChipGroup`. Under the controls, a placeholder body for the chosen dashboard (in an app, render the real dashboard block there, and `configurable-dashboard` for Custom): four `StatTile`s with a `Hint` each and the comparison period, a `ChartCard` with the dashboard's `Chart` and its tooltip total, and a `ChartCard` with a ranked `BarList`. Switching the dashboard loads its body (Skeletons in place); changing the period or pressing Refresh refetches it, holding the previous render. A dashboard that owns its period (Executive summary, Spend, Project status) hides the shared filter and its chip and shows its own quarter `ToggleGroup` instead. A page body: render it in the default slot of ConsoleLayout, which owns the rail, the header and the main.

variants.name: OwnPeriod
variants.summary: Executive summary chosen: a dashboard that owns its period, so the shared Filter and its Period chip are hidden and a quarter `ToggleGroup` takes their place in the controls row; the tiles compare against the previous quarter and the chart runs week by week.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The body of the chosen dashboard while it loads: the controls stay usable, the tiles, the chart and the ranked list render their own Skeleton in their final boxes, so nothing reflows when the data arrives.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The chosen dashboard could not load: the tiles show dashes and the chart and ranked-list cards keep their headers with a danger `Alert` and Retry, which refetches the body.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: The period has no data: the tiles show dashes, the chart and the ranked list show their empty state (`No data in this period`), and the controls stay usable to widen the period.
